clips.title: The story
paras: Sparring Match is an introductory trial overseen by the martial instructor Tang Stonehoof. Designed to test newcomers regardless of their class or background, the trial challenges adventurers to defeat three arena novices or fellow duelists to prove their mettle in direct combat.

Overseen by the veteran instructor Tang Stonehoof, the sparring match invites adventurers of all backgrounds into the ring to test their mettle. Though Tang specifically acknowledges those who walk paths outside the warrior tradition, he maintains that martial discipline and direct battle offer universal wisdom to any traveler in a dangerous world.

Within Tang Stonehoof's arena, distinctions of lineage and preferred weaponry fall away. Whether wielding sword, bow, or spellcraft, challengers are tasked with proving their combat readiness by defeating three willing opponents—either the training Novice Warriors or fellow adventurers in duels. Overcoming these bouts earns Tang's respect and bandages to dress the wounds of honest combat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, young adventurer. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.
Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.
Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You honor me with your abilities, adventurer. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.
Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
